fills.name: Mustering
fills.value: Holds technology from the Highlands and Lowlands. Each time a Landmark from a region is chosen, costs of their powerful technologies are reduced. Musters warriors using Food and Muster Charge costs. Each type of muster is one-time use. Generates influence to military production buildings. Each building provides a count towards Muster Hall levels to improve its mustering efficiency and adds additional Muster Charges. Comes with 1 Muster Charge by default.
fills.quote: Holds technology from the Highlands and Lowlands. ... Comes with 1 Muster Charge by default.
fills.note: Mustering Hall building tooltip. The early musters cost 600 food each.

Adds a muster charge.
